Sub: Proposals for grant of exemption from _EDLI Scheme 1976 and extension
thereof under Section 17(2A) of EPF & MP Act, 1952 — reg.

Ref :(i) Co-ord.2 (2)2002/Amend./Pt./4827 dated 14-06-2005.
(ii) No. C.III/Misc/EDLI/Exem/ 22893-22943 dated 24-7-2007.
(iii) CPFCletter No.CPFC/Exemp/SZ/Vol.II/2005/47860 dated26-03-2009.

Sir,

I am directed to invite attention to Headquarters” circular dated 14" June 2005
regarding revised procedure for processing applications seeking grant of exemption from EDLI
Scheme, 1976 u/s 17(12A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952. In this regard a further communication
was issued vide letter of even No. dated 23-05-2008 (copy enclosed) with a revised proforma
for sending the composite proposals by the Addl. CPFCs. It is stated that proposals are being
received in the old proforma in some cases and revised proforma is not being followed
(Annexure-I). This may kindly be followed for sending subsequent proposals to
Headquarters. It may clearly be indicated whether the cases are for grant of initial exemption
or extension of exemption and quoting the old notification issued.

2. Further, applications are being received in Headquarters’ from RPFCs in-charge and
also from establishments seeking extension of exemptions or status of notification in response
to applications which appear to have been sent to Headquarters prior to June 2005. The
records of the concerned Division in Head office do not confirm receipt of such applications. In
this regard attention is invited to Headquarters’ circular dated 24" July, 2007 (copy enclosed)
issued by Addl. CPFC(Compliance) wherein it has been clarified that the proposals received
earlier are not traceable and hence the Zonal Addl. CPFCs are required to send the proposals
again for necessary action. Thus, necessary instructions may be issued to the RPFCs in-charge
to re-send such proposals to Headquarters which were sent earlier to Headquarters’ for further
extension of exemption after due scrutiny.

3. Kind attention is also invited to the CPFC letter dated 26.03.2009 for general review of
exemption proposals by the Addl. CPFCs with RPFCs in-charge. It is requested that proposals
in respect of establishments which are due for grant of extension beyond 31.3.2009 may kindly
be expedited.

4. This issues with the approval of the Central Provident Fund Commissioner.

Yours faithfully,

Encl: As above.

Gem REGIONAL P.F.COMMISSIONER (Conf..)

Subject: Proposals for grant of exemption from EDLI Scheme, 1976
and extension thereof under Section 17(2A) of the EPF &
MP Act, 1952 — reg. .

Sir, °
Your attention is invited to Hars. circular dated 14% June 2005

regarding the revised procedure for processing applications for exemption from

EDLI Scheme, 1976 u/s 17(2A) of the EPF & MP Act, 1952. In this regard, a

further communication was issued based on the review of the composite

proposals received for notifications from Zonal Addl.CPFCs during the year 2006-

07 vide letter of even number dated 21.10.2007 (copy enclosed as Annexure-T)

wherein it was observed that while the proposals were being received regularly

from south zone, very few proposals were being received from other Zones.

A latest review by this office reveals the same trend. It is also
revealed in addition that in a number of cases the period of exemption is due for
expiry. The Zonal Addl. CPFCs may conduct a general review in respect of the

establishments in the Regions undér thir jurisdiction and report to this office by
31.5.2008 that — ~
% there are no more establishments in respect of which proposals for
notifications by CPFC for grant/extension of EDLI exemptions are
pending; and
> in respect of all the remaining establishments compliance is being
secured as establishments not exempted from the EDLI Scheme, 1976.

Attention is also invited toward this office circular no.C-
III/Misc./EDLI/Exm./EZ/22893-22943 dated 24.7.2007 (copy enclosed as
Annexure-iI) regarding the processing of applications for exemption and
extension under Section 17(2A). You are requested to adhere to the guidelines

mentioned therein.

The proforma for forwardii.g the cases for notification of exemption
has been slightly modified as in Annexure-III. The future cases may be
forwarded to RC (HQ) in this modified proforma.

Yours faithfully,

Encl.: As above.
